title: Eaglercraft 1.12.2
description: Full Minecraft 1.12.2 Java Edition ported to browser WebAssembly & JavaScript. Includes singleplayer worlds, multiplayer servers, shaders, sound packs, and custom skins.
controls: WASD / Arrow Keys - Walk and move
Right Click - Place blocks / Use item
Mouse Movement - Look around (click canvas to lock mouse)
sandbox: allow-scripts allow-same-origin allow-pointer-lock allow-forms allow-modals allow-downloads
sourceNote: Ported via TeaVM & WebAssembly to run Java bytecode directly in browser.

title: Retro Bowl
description: The ultimate 8-bit American Football management and arcade simulation game. Call plays, draft rookies, and lead your franchise to glory.
controls: Mouse / Touch - Aim and throw pass
Click play calls to select tactics

title: Cookie Clicker
description: The iconic idle incremental game. Click the giant cookie, hire grandmas, construct cookie farms, factories, and portals to amass trillions of cookies.
controls: Left Click - Click the big cookie
Store Panel - Buy upgrades and buildings

title: Slope 3D
description: High-velocity 3D runner where you guide a rolling neon ball through an endless futuristic obstacle course. Speed ramps up with every second survived.
controls: A / D or Left / Right Arrows - Steer left and right
Stay on track and dodge red barriers

title: 2048 Classic
description: Join matching numbered tiles and slide the grid strategically to build the legendary 2048 tile and reach higher highscores.
controls: Arrow Keys / WASD / Swipe - Slide all tiles on the board
Tiles with the same number merge into one

title: Flappy Pixel
description: Tap or press space to flap wings and navigate through pipes without hitting obstacles in this retro arcade classic.
controls: Spacebar / Click / Tap - Flap wings upwards

title: Neon Snake Arcade
description: Vibrant arcade reboot of Snake with multiple speed tiers, glowing energy pellets, particle effects, and high score tracking.
controls: Arrow Keys or W/A/S/D - Turn snake direction
Eat neon orbs to grow longer and boost multiplier

title: Space Defender 1980
description: Defend the planetary perimeter against descending alien fleets. Blast through shields, intercept mystery ships, and dodge incoming laser barrages.
controls: Left / Right Arrows or A/D - Move starfighter

title: Neon Brick Breaker
description: Fast-paced paddle action with multi-ball powerups, explosive bricks, laser shots, and challenging brick layouts.
controls: Mouse / Arrow Keys - Steer paddle horizontally
Spacebar / Click - Launch ball / Fire lasers
Catch powerup capsules for bonus effects

title: T-Rex Runner
description: The classic desert runner game. Leap over cacti and duck beneath pterodactyls with day and night cycles.
controls: Down Arrow - Crouch / Duck under birds

title: Cyber Pong Tournament
description: Futuristic electronic table tennis featuring smart AI opponents, curved ball physics, and 2-player local vs mode.
